name: COMMUNITY-ACTIVE-RELATIONS
status: Closed by User v0.1.1 authorization and controller-approved cross-batch consistency. Effective contract: relations-v0.1.json (version 0.1.1).

communitySemantics.pageAndCount: Apply the same counterparty eligibility predicate before counting and paging. Preserve the original relation order among eligible rows and the canonical decimal-string total.
communitySemantics.writeScope: Retain durable relations for inactive accounts and allow the authenticated follower to cancel without consulting User.
communitySemantics.failure: If eligibility cannot be determined under the approved consistency budget, map to dependency unavailable. Do not return a partial list or an assumed valid count.

resolved.decision: Use authorized bounded synchronous validity reads; no extra User purpose or revisioned feed in this release.

historicalMinimumRequest.decision: Authorize the Community caller to resolve both endpoints of existing relationships for list and count reads. Either explicitly extend FOLLOW_TARGET to cover that use or add the purpose RELATION_READ under the existing audience and permission.

historicalOptions.boundedOption: If controller approves a concrete maximum relationship cardinality and a batched-read consistency window, resolve all eligible counterparts in bounded batches before deriving count and page.
historicalOptions.unboundedOption: If existing cardinality and latency limits remain, provide a revisioned account eligibility snapshot or export with ordered activation/deactivation/deletion updates and a watermark; build a Community-owned eligibility projection, and perform the filter and count in one local SQL view.
validation: More than one page of mixed active/inactive counterparts with inactive rows before and within the first page
Following/follower totals and Content profile counts agree for the same eligibility snapshot
Inactive relationship can still be deleted when User is unavailable
